newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end mixed in thin trade.

text.p: * APEC holiday keeps most market participants away
Manila shares ended mixed on Monday in lacklustre trading amid the holidays announced for the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, traders said.
The composite index rose 2.10 points to end at 3,104.46 following Friday's 3.25-point gain.
But losers outpaced gainers 61 to 38, with 80 issues unchanged. The declines mainly came from the small, speculative stocks, traders said.
"The market was basically sideways. There's not too much volume but pretty decent considering it's a holiday," said Ricky Trinidad, vice president for sales of Sun Hung Kai Securities.
The main index was propped up by select issues, traders said

These included Ayala Land Class B shares which added 50 centavos to 28 pesos; Manila Electric Class A and B shares, both of which gained one peso each to finish at 107 and 195 pesos respectively; and San Miguel Corp Class B shares which rose 1.50 pesos to 48 pesos.
Trinindad believes the market should pick up by the middle of this week when local investors return from their vacation.
